name: core-runtime-deterministic-tail-local-evidence-api67
notes: Exact-candidate deterministic local witness for FeatureManagement.checkPermission(String) and Http.send(HttpRequest) through a registered local callout mock.
salesforceExclusionReason: Deterministic local permission and mock-callout behavior claims zero Salesforce parity.

source.content: public class CoreRuntimeDeterministicTailMock implements HttpCalloutMock { public HttpResponse respond(HttpRequest request) { System.assertEquals('https://example.test/deterministic-tail', request.getEndpoint()); HttpResponse response = new HttpResponse(); response.setStatusCode(204); response.setBody('deterministic-tail'); return response; } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeDeterministicTailLocalEvidenceApi67Test { @isTest static void rows() { System.runAs(new User(Id = '005-user-deterministic-tail', Username = 'deterministic-tail@example.test', Permissions = 'CanRunLocal')) { System.assert(FeatureManagement.checkPermission('CanRunLocal')); System.assert(!FeatureManagement.checkPermission('OtherPermission')); } Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new CoreRuntimeDeterministicTailMock()); HttpRequest request = new HttpRequest(); request.setEndpoint('https://example.test/deterministic-tail'); request.setMethod('GET'); HttpResponse response = new Http().send(request); System.assertEquals(204, response.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('deterministic-tail', response.getBody()); } }
